The '''Sky Torch''' was a weapon designed by the eccentric [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]], one of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] chief [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]. Godera began the project sometime before the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], as he resigned his position of Chief Designer at the Republic's [[Advanced Development Laboratories]] in disgust when the Republic accepted the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sky Torch was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
